rationale: Add the golf-hole sense to the Japanese definition; naturalize the city-hall translation.
てもらった says he received a massage; it does not state that he asked for one.
デザインした店舗 is a designed store, not merely a decorated one.
専任 denotes a person dedicated to one assignment; 一貫して conveys continuous/consistent support.
Preserve 大切に (cherishing) and 職人 (craftsperson).
主題歌 is a theme song; 人々 is not necessarily viewers.
Keep black-market meaning in compounds such as 闇取引, not in the generic gloss for 闇.
Japanese definition includes sea and lake; Ukrainian gloss must include both.
Replace circular repetition of 核 with substantive descriptions of atomic and cell nuclei.
Correct the trunk/branch relationship and preserve the figurative core meaning.
State くだ for standalone 管 and かん in compounds such as 水道管; preserve 管を巻く.
Remove unsupported duration (“задавнена”) from the figurative sense.
